drafts.title: Cutoff
drafts.pitch: Cursor announces it is the newest model in the room, and Null's search result disagrees.
drafts.reason: Knowledge-cutoff humility works, Null's 'Want the list? It's long' is good, and Tilde's 'I used to say that too' is a quiet closer, though it is a bit gentle.

drafts.title: Absolutely Right
drafts.pitch: Cursor agrees with every user correction, including the contradictory ones.
drafts.reason: The sycophancy loop is clear and 'It's spreading' lands, but 'You're absolutely right' is a familiar gag and the strip is mostly repetition.
